description: This Java class 'JwtAuthenticationFactory' serves as a factory for creating and managing JWT-related security components such as validators and public key providers. It is part of a security package within an authentication module, handling OAuth configurations, caching of public keys, and instantiation of JWT validation objects.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating JWT authentication components such as validators and key providers, configured with OAuth and cache settings.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new JwtAuthenticationFactory instance with specified OAuth, cache, and HTTP client configurations.

methods.name: getJwtValidator
methods.description: Returns the JwtValidator, creating it if it has not been initialized.

methods.name: getPublicKeyProvider
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PublicKeyProvider used to fetch public keys for JWT validation.

methods.name: getJwtSubjectIssuersConfig
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JwtSubjectIssuersConfig based on OAuth configuration.

methods.name: newJwtAuthenticationResultProvider
methods.description: Creates a new JwtAuthenticationResultProvider based on the current JwtSubjectIssuersConfig.
